I don't just create pretty graphics—I craft visual languages that make people stop scrolling and take action.

✦ Frictionless Collaboration

How We Will Work Together

A transparent, highly organized 4-stage process ensuring your project is delivered on schedule and exceeds expectations.

01

Discovery & Briefing

We dive deep into your project goals, target audience, brand values, and competitors through an in-depth kickoff questionnaire.

02

Moodboard & Concepts

I develop 2-3 distinct creative directions and interactive moodboards so we align on visual tone, color palette, and styling early.

03

Execution & Refinement

Translating the chosen direction into high-fidelity deliverables, with 2-3 structured feedback loops to polish every pixel.

04

Handoff & Launch

Delivery of production-ready vector assets, Figma tokens, print dielines, font files, and full copyright ownership transfer.

✦ Have Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about initiating a freelance project with Anokhi.

What are your typical project turnaround times? +
Typical turnaround times depend on project scope: Social Media Kits take 5-7 business days, Brand Identity Systems require 2-3 weeks, and full UI/UX mobile/web projects range between 3-4 weeks. Expedited rush deliveries are also available upon request.
Do I own the full intellectual property rights to the final designs? +
Yes, 100%! Upon final payment completion, all commercial copyright, intellectual property, and master source files (AI, EPS, SVG, Figma, PSD) are transferred completely to you.
How do revisions work? +
All project packages include up to 3 structured rounds of revisions at key milestones (concept review, design refinement, and final polishing). My goal is your complete satisfaction with the finished deliverable.
Are you open to full-time or contract retainer roles? +
Yes! As stated on my Behance profile, I am available for both freelance project contracts and ongoing full-time remote opportunities with international and Indian teams.
